fieldValues.title: Layers: SemanticOps
fieldValues.article_text: Layers that stay apart: purpose and governance (why, who decides); the standard (srs); the implementation (srs-rust); the surfaces (srs-web, srs-vscode, semanticops.com). Across all of them the human layer is separate from the agent layer. Rule: rulings flow down, never up. A lower layer stands alone; an upper layer cites the one below and never restates it.
fieldValues.rationale: Generalises compass rules 2 and 5 and ADR-048 rule 1.
fieldValues.protected_status: Agent suggestion until the owner affirms it.
